doc: Check timelines, read what plays at a moment, make the usual edits and take them back.

tools.name: timeline.check
tools.description: The timeline (rate, size, tracks and clips, markers, length), or every problem at its line and column

file.description: a file or directory path: a *.timeline.omui.json (what a .timeline.omui.ts evaluates to: omui-gen snapshot)

tools.name: timeline.at
tools.description: What plays at a moment: each clip, where in its source, at what level

tools.name: timeline.edit
tools.description: Split, trim, move, remove or ripple-remove a clip; the file written as the edit leaves it (or only said, with dry_run)

edit.description: split, trim, move, remove or ripple-remove

clip.description: the clip's index on its track

at.description: split: where; trim: the new start; move: the new start

to_track.description: move: another track of its kind

dry_run.description: only say what it would leave

tools.name: timeline.undo
tools.description: Take back the last edit this command made to the file (its text before it restored exactly; the last 64 kept)
